jobs.title: Studentische Teilzeitkraft Archiv Grünes Gedächtnis (w/m/d/k.A.)
jobs.reason: This is explicitly a studentische Teilzeitkraft (working-student) role, which is excluded as a matter of policy. Even though the Green Party archive could touch the candidate's interest in German Green foreign-policy history, the role type is a hard disqualifier.

jobs.title: Projektbearbeitung Bereich Inland – Schwerpunkt Demokratie und Gesellschaft (w/m/d/k.A.)
jobs.reason: A full-time project-administration post in domestic democracy-and-society work that plausibly fits the candidate's project-coordination and research-support experience at an entry-to-junior level, though the exact seniority and skills profile are unclear from the brief listing. The thematic area (German democracy/society) is adjacent rather than core to the candidate's international-law and atrocity-prevention focus, which holds the interest pull down.

jobs.title: Projektbearbeitung materielle Förderung (w/m/d/k.A.)
jobs.reason: The application deadline of 2026-06-28 has passed (today is 2026-06-29), so this vacancy is closed. The funding-administration work in the scholarship body (Studienwerk) would otherwise be a plausible fit given the candidate's experience allocating federal HEI funding, but the role is no longer open.

jobs.title: Studentische Teilzeitkraft Archiv Grünes Gedächtnis (w/m/d/k.A.)
jobs.reason: This is a studentische Teilzeitkraft (working-student) role requiring current enrolment at a German university, which is excluded as a matter of policy. It is also archive-clerical work outside the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Projektbearbeitung Bereich Inland - Schwerpunkt Demokratie und Gesellschaft (w/m/d/k.A.)
jobs.reason: Genuinely entry-level (Bachelor sufficient) and the project-administration, funding-allocation and stakeholder-coordination tasks map closely to the candidate's German Rectors' Conference experience handling €1.7m of federal funding, so paper fit is solid. However, it is an administrative project-management role focused on domestic political-education programmes rather than international law, security or geopolitical research, so it sits well outside the core interest zones and leans on project-management experience the candidate only partly has.

jobs.title: Programme Support Intern - Events & Advocacy
jobs.reason: This is an explicitly unpaid internship requiring a university agreement, which is excluded as a matter of policy. It also requires proficiency in Bulgarian, which the candidate does not have. The EU foreign-policy think-tank context is a strong interest match, but the role fails on both hard gates.

jobs.title: Wiss. Mitarbeiter*in (Praedoc) — Öffentliches Recht / Völkerrecht (Prof. Dr. Heike Krieger)
jobs.reason: The essential requirement is an abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium with the Erste juristische Prüfung — a German law degree / first state law exam the candidate does not hold, which is a hard qualification disqualifier. Despite a perfect topical match (international law, humanitarian law, human rights, with a doctoral option), the legal qualification is an unmet essential.
